$comment: Every refusal code the document operations answer, with the status and the exact sentence. TypeScript (`packages/model/src/generated/refusals.ts`) and Rust (`crates/ops/api-contracts/src/generated/refusals.rs`) are generated from this file by `cargo xtask codegen`; edit here. A message is a template: `{name}` fills a param, `{name|filter}` a filtered one (json, trim, s, list, and_list, json_list, quoted_list), `{{` and `}}` are braces. `example` and `exampleText` pin one rendering per entry, which both languages and the TypeScript classes are held to.

surfaces.api-v1: the `/api/v1` routes `createServer` mounts, and the MCP tools over the same operations
surfaces.sync-write: the surfaces a sync write passes through: a document's update, the workspace record's update and promote, and a restore carrying a saved state
surfaces.documents-api: the daemon's `/api/workspaces/:workspaceId/...` document routes, which answer from mcp-server
surfaces.mcp-tools: MCP tools, which raise the refusal as a tool error: the message travels, the code does not

refusals.exampleText: This update would give "a", "b" a display name past 200 characters, the most a name may have

refusals.name: FolderNameRefused
refusals.description: Folders an update would give a display name no folder may have; the reason is the folder-name rule's own sentence.
refusals.message: This update would give the folder {paths|json_list} a name no folder may have. {reason}

example.reason: A folder name cannot be blank.

refusals.exampleText: This update would give the folder "a" a name no folder may have. A folder name cannot be blank.

refusals.name: CausalGap
refusals.description: An update building on changes this keeper has not received; sending again once it holds them lands.
refusals.message: This update builds on changes this keeper has not received yet, so nothing of it was kept. Send the changes it builds on first
refusals.exampleText: This update builds on changes this keeper has not received yet, so nothing of it was kept. Send the changes it builds on first

refusals.name: TooManyDocuments
refusals.description: A write leaving the workspace record listing more documents than a workspace holds.
refusals.message: This write would leave the workspace holding {documents} documents; a workspace holds at most {limit}. Move some documents to another workspace first
refusals.exampleText: This write would leave the workspace holding 2001 documents; a workspace holds at most 2000. Move some documents to another workspace first

refusals.name: TooManyFolders
refusals.description: A write leaving the workspace record listing more folders than a workspace holds.
refusals.message: This write would leave the workspace holding {folders} folders; a workspace holds at most {limit}. Move or delete some folders' documents first
refusals.exampleText: This write would leave the workspace holding 4001 folders; a workspace holds at most 4000. Move or delete some folders' documents first

refusals.name: TooManyWorkspaces
refusals.description: A workspace create in a namespace already holding the most workspaces one person may hold on a shared keeper.
refusals.message: "{namespace}" already holds {limit} workspaces, the most one person may hold on this server
refusals.exampleText: "ns" already holds 1000 workspaces, the most one person may hold on this server

refusals.name: TooManyVersions
refusals.description: A manual version save past the document's version ceiling, or a restore point past the same ceiling.
refusals.message: This document already keeps {limit} saved versions, the most one document keeps; no further version can be saved for it
refusals.exampleText: This document already keeps 50 saved versions, the most one document keeps; no further version can be saved for it

refusals.name: DocumentNotFound
refusals.description: A document the workspace does not hold, named for an MCP caller.
refusals.message: Document not found: {documentId} in workspace {workspaceId}
refusals.exampleText: Document not found: d1 in workspace w1

refusals.name: DocumentNotFoundInIndex
refusals.description: A document the index does not hold, named by the path or id the caller gave.
refusals.message: No document "{target}" in workspace "{workspaceId}"
refusals.exampleText: No document "a/b" in workspace "w1"

refusals.name: DocumentSnapshotNotFound
refusals.description: A document indexed but never written, so holding no stored bytes.
refusals.message: document has no saved snapshot: {documentId}
refusals.exampleText: document has no saved snapshot: d1

refusals.name: DocumentEngineTrapLoading
refusals.description: The CRDT engine aborted while the CRDT engine loaded a document; the caller cannot fix it by rewording.
refusals.message: The CRDT engine aborted while loading {subject}; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. If the same document fails again, its in-memory copy is unusable until the daemon restarts or the document is deleted.
refusals.exampleText: The CRDT engine aborted while loading document d1; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. If the same document fails again, its in-memory copy is unusable until the daemon restarts or the document is deleted.

refusals.name: DocumentEngineTrapSaving
refusals.description: The CRDT engine aborted while the CRDT engine saved a document; the caller cannot fix it by rewording.
refusals.message: The CRDT engine aborted while saving {subject}; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. If the same document fails again, its in-memory copy is unusable until the daemon restarts or the document is deleted.
refusals.exampleText: The CRDT engine aborted while saving document d1; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. If the same document fails again, its in-memory copy is unusable until the daemon restarts or the document is deleted.

refusals.name: DocumentEngineTrapImporting
refusals.description: The CRDT engine aborted while the CRDT engine took a client's update; the caller cannot fix it by rewording.
refusals.message: The CRDT engine aborted while importing an update into {subject}; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. The in-memory copy was dropped, so the next request reloads what was stored; sending the same update again aborts the same way. After a trap this process may abort on other large writes too, until the daemon restarts.
refusals.exampleText: The CRDT engine aborted while importing an update into document d1; nothing from this write was stored. A very large document is the usual trigger. The in-memory copy was dropped, so the next request reloads what was stored; sending the same update again aborts the same way. After a trap this process may abort on other large writes too, until the daemon restarts.

refusals.name: DocumentEngineTrapRunningRecovered
refusals.description: The Rust core aborted running an operation and was reset.
refusals.message: The Rust core aborted while running {subject}; nothing from this request was stored. The core was reset, so the next request runs on a fresh instance; sending the same input again may abort the same way.
refusals.exampleText: The Rust core aborted while running layout; nothing from this request was stored. The core was reset, so the next request runs on a fresh instance; sending the same input again may abort the same way.

refusals.name: DocumentEngineTrapRunningUnrecoverable
refusals.description: The Rust core aborted running an operation and could not be reset.
refusals.message: The Rust core aborted while running {subject}; nothing from this request was stored. The core could not be reset and answers every request with this until the daemon restarts.
refusals.exampleText: The Rust core aborted while running layout; nothing from this request was stored. The core could not be reset and answers every request with this until the daemon restarts.

refusals.name: DocumentKindMismatch
refusals.description: A write in a format the document is not in; `detail` carries the per-tool consequence and the tool to use instead.
refusals.message: Document {documentId} is a {kind} document. {detail}
refusals.exampleText: Document d1 is a markdown document. Use wb_body_edit.

refusals.name: NodeNotFound
refusals.description: A tool naming a node the canvas does not hold.
refusals.message: node not found: {nodeId} in document {documentId}
refusals.exampleText: node not found: n1 in document d1

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundForCallerRead
refusals.description: A workspace nothing answers to, in the advice for a read, no other workspace known.
refusals.message: Workspace not found: "{workspaceId}". Check the id against the workspaces you know, or create one with wb_workspace_edit (createWorkspace: true).
refusals.exampleText: Workspace not found: "w1". Check the id against the workspaces you know, or create one with wb_workspace_edit (createWorkspace: true).

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundForCallerReadKnown
refusals.description: The same, naming the workspaces that do exist.
refusals.message: Workspace not found: "{workspaceId}". Workspaces here: {known|quoted_list}. Check the id against the workspaces you know, or create one with wb_workspace_edit (createWorkspace: true).
refusals.exampleText: Workspace not found: "w1". Workspaces here: "a", "b". Check the id against the workspaces you know, or create one with wb_workspace_edit (createWorkspace: true).

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundForCallerCreate
refusals.description: A workspace nothing answers to, in the advice for a create, no other workspace known.
refusals.message: Workspace not found: "{workspaceId}". Pass createWorkspace: true on this wb_workspace_edit call to create it along with the document.
refusals.exampleText: Workspace not found: "w1". Pass createWorkspace: true on this wb_workspace_edit call to create it along with the document.

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundForCallerCreateKnown
refusals.description: The same, naming the workspaces that do exist.
refusals.message: Workspace not found: "{workspaceId}". Workspaces here: {known|quoted_list}. Pass createWorkspace: true on this wb_workspace_edit call to create it along with the document.
refusals.exampleText: Workspace not found: "w1". Workspaces here: "a", "b". Pass createWorkspace: true on this wb_workspace_edit call to create it along with the document.

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundInIndex
refusals.description: A workspace the index does not hold; workspaces never materialize implicitly.
refusals.message: Workspace not found: "{workspaceId}". Create it before adding documents to it.
refusals.exampleText: Workspace not found: "w1". Create it before adding documents to it.

refusals.name: WorkspaceNotFoundByHandle
refusals.description: A workspace nothing answers to, in the one voice the daemon's document routes answer it, naming the handle the caller typed.
refusals.message: Workspace "{handle}" not found
refusals.exampleText: Workspace "w1" not found

refusals.name: DocumentPathTaken
refusals.description: A create or move onto a path the workspace already holds.
refusals.message: Document path "{path}" already exists in workspace "{workspaceId}"
refusals.exampleText: Document path "a/b" already exists in workspace "w1"

refusals.name: DisplayNameTaken
refusals.description: A name a sibling of the same kind under the same parent already shows; the displayName is trimmed as the sentence quotes it.
refusals.message: Another {kind} here is already called "{displayName|trim}". Choose a name no other {kind} here has.
refusals.exampleText: Another folder here is already called "Notes". Choose a name no other folder here has.

refusals.name: WorkspaceSegmentTaken
refusals.description: A workspace segment another workspace in the registry already holds.
refusals.message: Workspace segment "{segment}" is already taken
refusals.exampleText: Workspace segment "notes" is already taken

refusals.name: WorkspaceSegmentTakenInNamespace
refusals.description: The same, in a registry shared by several namespaces.
refusals.message: Workspace segment "{segment}" is already taken in namespace "{namespace}"
refusals.exampleText: Workspace segment "notes" is already taken in namespace "ns"

refusals.name: WorkspaceSegmentUnusable
refusals.description: A create naming a handle that could never be a segment.
refusals.message: Cannot create workspace "{handle}": a new workspace is addressed by its segment, which must be ASCII letters, digits and interior hyphens, and must not itself be shaped like a canonical id. Choose a name that fits, or address an existing workspace by its id.
refusals.exampleText: Cannot create workspace "no way!": a new workspace is addressed by its segment, which must be ASCII letters, digits and interior hyphens, and must not itself be shaped like a canonical id. Choose a name that fits, or address an existing workspace by its id.

refusals.name: DocumentNameConflict
refusals.description: A create given a display name twice, as `name` and as the frontmatter title, and the two disagree.
refusals.message: name "{given}" and the frontmatter title "{title}" are two display names for one document. Give one of them, or make them the same.
refusals.exampleText: name "A" and the frontmatter title "B" are two display names for one document. Give one of them, or make them the same.

refusals.name: DocumentHasDescendants
refusals.description: A delete or move that would strand or swallow the documents below its target; `detail` says which to delete first.
refusals.message: Document "{path}" has descendants. {detail}
refusals.exampleText: Document "a" has descendants. Delete a/b first.

refusals.name: DocumentMoveIntoSelf
refusals.description: A move whose destination lies inside the subtree being moved.
refusals.message: Cannot move "{from}" to "{to}": the destination is inside the subtree being moved
refusals.exampleText: Cannot move "a" to "a/b": the destination is inside the subtree being moved

refusals.name: CannotPlaceCopyContested
refusals.description: A duplicate of a path that more than one document carries.
refusals.message: More than one document carries "{path}" in workspace "{workspaceId}". Resolve by documentId, or rename one of them.
refusals.exampleText: More than one document carries "a" in workspace "w1". Resolve by documentId, or rename one of them.

refusals.name: CannotPlaceCopyNoRoom
refusals.description: A duplicate of a document whose folder is so deep that no copy segment fits beside it.
refusals.message: There is no room beside "{path}" for a copy: its folder's path is too long.
refusals.exampleText: There is no room beside "a/b" for a copy: its folder's path is too long.

refusals.name: DocumentSerializeFailed
refusals.description: A stored value the document's format has no spelling for; `cause` is the thrown error as its reader words it.
refusals.message: Document {documentId} cannot be read as {format}: {cause}. Rewrite it with `wb_workspace_edit`'s `document.set` op to repair it.
refusals.exampleText: Document d1 cannot be read as okf: a value YAML cannot carry. Rewrite it with `wb_workspace_edit`'s `document.set` op to repair it.

refusals.name: StoredDocumentUnsupportedVersion
refusals.description: A stored record intact in a shape this build does not know: the reader is old, the data is not damaged. The message is the keeper's own.
refusals.message: {message}
refusals.exampleText: stored under version 9

refusals.name: CorruptStoredData
refusals.description: A stored record the keeper holds and cannot read back, or a chunk set that does not reassemble. The message is the keeper's own.
refusals.message: {message}
refusals.exampleText: does not parse

refusals.name: RetiredCommentPlane
refusals.description: A document still holding comments in the plane before threads, which no reader serves; its data is untouched.
refusals.message: this document holds {rows} comment{rows|s} saved by an older version in a form this version no longer reads (the flat comments plane before threads); its data has not been changed
refusals.exampleText: this document holds 2 comments saved by an older version in a form this version no longer reads (the flat comments plane before threads); its data has not been changed

refusals.name: RetiredStoredShape
refusals.description: A document still holding a shape an older version stored and no reader serves; its data is untouched.
refusals.message: this document holds {found}, saved by an older version in a form this version no longer reads; its data has not been changed

example.found: node "n1" stored under the retired key

refusals.exampleText: this document holds node "n1" stored under the retired key, saved by an older version in a form this version no longer reads; its data has not been changed

refusals.name: ReferenceRewriteBodyTooLarge
refusals.description: A reference rewrite that would leave a markdown body past the limit.
refusals.message: The links would make the document body {chars} characters long, past {limit}

example.limit: the 262144-character limit for one document; split the content across documents

refusals.exampleText: The links would make the document body 300000 characters long, past the 262144-character limit for one document; split the content across documents

refusals.name: ReferenceRewriteNodeTextTooLarge
refusals.description: A reference rewrite that would leave a node's text past the limit.
refusals.message: The links would give node {nodeId|json} {chars} characters of text, past {limit}

example.limit: the 8192-character limit for one node; split it across nodes, or put it in a markdown document and embed that

refusals.exampleText: The links would give node "n1" 70000 characters of text, past the 8192-character limit for one node; split it across nodes, or put it in a markdown document and embed that

refusals.name: OkfParseFailed
refusals.description: A markdown body that OKF cannot parse; `detail` is empty or names up to three issues.
refusals.message: OKF parse failed at {stage}: {message}{detail}
refusals.exampleText: OKF parse failed at frontmatter: bad yaml — a.b: nope

refusals.name: OkfNotYamlSafe
refusals.description: A value YAML has no spelling for, refused while the caller still holds the content; same sentence as a parse failure, its own code.
refusals.message: OKF parse failed at {stage}: {message}{detail}
refusals.exampleText: OKF parse failed at yaml-safe: .nan has no YAML spelling

refusals.name: TagNotAdmitted
refusals.description: A tag value the workspace's own library does not admit under its key.
refusals.message: tag "{tag}" on {what} is not admitted: the workspace's tag library (the document at "{libraryPath}") declares {key} as one of {admitted|list}
refusals.exampleText: tag "env:qa" on the board is not admitted: the workspace's tag library (the document at "tags") declares env as one of dev, prod

refusals.name: TagExclusive
refusals.description: Two values under a key the library declares exclusive.
refusals.message: {key} is one value at a time in the workspace's tag library (the document at "{libraryPath}"), and this write leaves {what} with {carried|and_list}
refusals.exampleText: env is one value at a time in the workspace's tag library (the document at "tags"), and this write leaves node redis with env:dev and env:prod

refusals.name: FacetWriteRejected
refusals.description: A registered facet's payload its own schema refuses, or one written where it does not belong; `reason` names what to change.
refusals.message: facet "{facetKey}" rejected: {reason}
refusals.exampleText: facet "visual.shape/v1" rejected: bad payload

refusals.name: FacetSetNeedsPayload
refusals.description: A facet write naming neither tags nor facets, which a silent no-op would read as done.
refusals.message: Nothing to set: pass `tags` (add/remove tags) or `facets` (extension facets), or both.
refusals.exampleText: Nothing to set: pass `tags` (add/remove tags) or `facets` (extension facets), or both.

refusals.name: DocumentHasNoFrontmatter
refusals.description: A tag written to a markdown document that holds no OKF frontmatter yet to put it in.
refusals.message: Document {documentId} has no OKF frontmatter to tag. Write its content first with wb_workspace_edit's document.set op (a markdown body starting with a --- frontmatter block), then tag it.
refusals.exampleText: Document d1 has no OKF frontmatter to tag. Write its content first with wb_workspace_edit's document.set op (a markdown body starting with a --- frontmatter block), then tag it.

refusals.name: NodeTargetNeedsOneDocument
refusals.description: A node or edge named beside several documents, whose element ids are scoped to their own document.
refusals.message: nodeId names a node of ONE document, and {count} documentIds were given. Node ids are scoped to their own document, so the same nodeId in two documents is two unrelated nodes. Call once per document.
refusals.exampleText: nodeId names a node of ONE document, and 2 documentIds were given. Node ids are scoped to their own document, so the same nodeId in two documents is two unrelated nodes. Call once per document.

refusals.name: NodeAndEdgeTarget
refusals.description: A write naming a node and an edge, when it lands on one element.
refusals.message: nodeId targets a node and edgeId targets an edge; pass one or the other.
refusals.exampleText: nodeId targets a node and edgeId targets an edge; pass one or the other.

refusals.name: NodeAndCanvasTarget
refusals.description: A write naming an element and the canvas around it, when it lands on one.
refusals.message: nodeId targets one node and target: 'canvas' targets the canvas envelope; pass one or the other.
refusals.exampleText: nodeId targets one node and target: 'canvas' targets the canvas envelope; pass one or the other.

refusals.name: NodeLockedNothingWritten
refusals.description: A facet or tag write that would change a locked node, refused whole.
refusals.message: node "{id}" is locked; unlock it with a node.lock op first. Nothing was written.
refusals.exampleText: node "n1" is locked; unlock it with a node.lock op first. Nothing was written.

refusals.name: EdgeLockedNothingWritten
refusals.description: A facet or tag write that would change a locked edge, refused whole.
refusals.message: edge "{id}" is locked; unlock it with an edge.lock op first. Nothing was written.
refusals.exampleText: edge "e1" is locked; unlock it with an edge.lock op first. Nothing was written.

refusals.name: TooManyTagsOnElement
refusals.description: A tag change that would leave a document, board, node or edge carrying more tags than one may and more than it carries now.
refusals.message: {what} would carry {count} tags, past the 1024-tag limit for one document, board, node or edge. Nothing was written.
refusals.exampleText: node n1 would carry 1025 tags, past the 1024-tag limit for one document, board, node or edge. Nothing was written.

refusals.name: EdgeNotFound
refusals.description: A tool naming an edge the canvas does not hold.
refusals.message: edge not found: {edgeId} in document {documentId}
refusals.exampleText: edge not found: e1 in document d1

refusals.name: SearchNeedsQueryOrFilter
refusals.description: A search naming neither words nor a filter, in the tool's parameter names.
refusals.message: Nothing to search for: pass `query` (words to match), or `tags` / `kind` (a filter to answer alone), or both. To list every document, use wb_document_list.
refusals.exampleText: Nothing to search for: pass `query` (words to match), or `tags` / `kind` (a filter to answer alone), or both. To list every document, use wb_document_list.

refusals.name: SearchNeedsQueryOrFilterRoute
refusals.description: The same, in the query string's own parameter names.
refusals.message: Nothing to search for: pass `q` (words to match), or `tag` / `kind` (a filter to answer alone), or both.
refusals.exampleText: Nothing to search for: pass `q` (words to match), or `tag` / `kind` (a filter to answer alone), or both.

refusals.name: NamelessLinkifyTarget
refusals.description: A link-mentions target carrying no display name, so nothing names it in prose.
refusals.message: Document {targetDocumentId} has no display name — nothing names it in prose, so there is nothing to linkify.
refusals.exampleText: Document d1 has no display name — nothing names it in prose, so there is nothing to linkify.

refusals.name: InvalidBodyNotJson
refusals.description: A write whose body is not JSON.
refusals.message: the request body is not valid JSON
refusals.exampleText: the request body is not valid JSON

refusals.name: InvalidRequest
refusals.description: A request the schema or the route refuses; `reason` is composed by the caller (schema issues joined, an unknown query parameter, an identity named by the URL), which is the one place this contract does not own the sentence.
refusals.message: {reason}

example.reason: unknown query parameter "x"; it reads q

refusals.exampleText: unknown query parameter "x"; it reads q

refusals.name: DatabaseBusy
refusals.description: The database another process holds locked; the same request may succeed shortly (Retry-After: 1).
refusals.message: The database is busy; retry shortly.
refusals.exampleText: The database is busy; retry shortly.

refusals.name: InternalError
refusals.description: An uncaught throw. The body carries no part of the error: its message can hold a path, a statement or a secret.
refusals.message: The server failed to handle this request.
refusals.exampleText: The server failed to handle this request.

refusals.name: VersionNotFound
refusals.description: A restore naming a version the document's own history does not hold: none by that id, or another document's.
refusals.message: version not found: {versionId} in document {documentId}
refusals.exampleText: version not found: v1 in document d1

refusals.name: RestoreTargetExists
refusals.description: A restore into a targetPath that already holds a document, without overwrite.
refusals.message: target already exists: {targetPath} — pass overwrite: true to restore onto it
refusals.exampleText: target already exists: a/b — pass overwrite: true to restore onto it

refusals.name: SubtreeNeedsWorkspaceVersion
refusals.description: A subtree rollback to a version that does not carry the whole workspace at that point.
refusals.message: subtree rollback needs a workspace-scoped version: {versionId}
refusals.exampleText: subtree rollback needs a workspace-scoped version: v1

refusals.name: SubtreeTakesNoTarget
refusals.description: A subtree rollback asked to land at a targetPath other than where it rolls back.
refusals.message: subtree rollback cannot take a targetPath
refusals.exampleText: subtree rollback cannot take a targetPath

refusals.name: InvalidRestoreTargetPath
refusals.description: A restore targetPath that is not a document path, refused by the operation as the backstop no surface can skip.
refusals.message: invalid targetPath: {targetPath}
refusals.exampleText: invalid targetPath: a//b

refusals.name: RestoredDocumentIdMissing
refusals.description: A restore that landed at a path whose row lists no document id, so the caller cannot be told which document holds it.
refusals.message: restored document has no id: {targetPath}
refusals.exampleText: restored document has no id: a/b

refusals.name: ThreadEditOpRefused
refusals.description: One op of a `wb_thread_edit` batch that cannot be applied to the document as it stands; the batch is refused whole, so nothing of it was written.
refusals.message: ops[{opIndex}] ({op}) could not be applied: {detail}. Nothing was written.

example.detail: thread "t1" is not on this document

refusals.exampleText: ops[1] (thread.resolve) could not be applied: thread "t1" is not on this document. Nothing was written.

refusals.name: DocumentMoveNeedsTarget
refusals.description: A `document.move` op naming neither a path to move the document to nor a name to rename it to.
refusals.message: a move needs a `path` to move it, a `name` to rename it, or both
refusals.exampleText: a move needs a `path` to move it, a `name` to rename it, or both

refusals.name: WorkspaceEditOpRefused
refusals.description: One op of a `wb_workspace_edit` batch that could not be applied. A batch spans documents with no transaction over them, so the ops before it stand and the ops after it were not run.
refusals.message: ops[{opIndex}] ({op}) could not be applied: {detail}. {applied} op(s) before it were applied and stand; ops after it were not run. Resume from this index rather than resending the batch.

example.detail: Document not found: d1 in workspace w1

refusals.exampleText: ops[2] (document.move) could not be applied: Document not found: d1 in workspace w1. 2 op(s) before it were applied and stand; ops after it were not run. Resume from this index rather than resending the batch.
